source: Live run #4 (n8n execution of DqMonitorFlow001), 2026-11-16. Fictional Contoso Pay data; personal data masked before sending.

actions.check_sql:
SELECT lower(email), 'used by customers ' || string_agg(customer_id::text, ', ' ORDER BY customer_id)
      FROM wallet.customers WHERE email IS NOT NULL AND btrim(email) <> ''
     GROUP BY lower(email) HAVING count(*) > 1
actions.description: An email identifies one customer. A shared email can send one customer's alerts to another.

actions.check_sql:
SELECT customer_id::text, 'email "' || email || '"'
      FROM wallet.customers
     WHERE email IS NOT NULL AND btrim(email) <> '' AND email !~ '^[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}$'
actions.rule_name: Customer email is not a valid address
actions.description: Emails must look like name@domain.tld, or messages bounce.

actions.check_sql:
SELECT customer_id::text, 'customer ' || customer_id || ' has no email (value is ' ||
           CASE WHEN email IS NULL THEN 'NULL' WHEN email = '' THEN 'an empty string' ELSE 'only spaces' END || ')'
      FROM wallet.customers WHERE email IS NULL OR btrim(email) = ''
actions.description: Every customer needs an email address for receipts, password resets and security alerts.

sample_rows.detail: customer 1052 has no email (value is only spaces)
customer 1816 has no email (value is NULL)
customer 1850 has no email (value is an empty string)

actions.check_sql:
SELECT customer_id::text, 'kyc_status "' || coalesce(kyc_status, 'NULL') || '"'
      FROM wallet.customers WHERE kyc_status IS NULL OR kyc_status NOT IN ('verified', 'pending', 'rejected')
actions.rule_name: KYC status is not an allowed value
actions.description: KYC status must be verified, pending or rejected; anything else breaks transaction limits and reporting.

actions.check_sql:
SELECT feed_name, source_system || ' last loaded ' || round(extract(epoch FROM now() - last_loaded_at) / 3600, 1) ||
           ' h ago; SLA ' || sla_hours || ' h'
      FROM wallet.feed_loads WHERE last_loaded_at IS NULL OR last_loaded_at < now() - make_interval(hours => sla_hours)
actions.description: Each source feed must have loaded within its service level (sla_hours).

sample_rows.detail: Card processor last loaded 50.0 h ago; SLA 24 h

actions.check_sql:
SELECT wallet_id || '@' || ledger_date, 'opening ' || opening_balance || ' + credits ' || total_credits ||
           ' - debits ' || total_debits || ' = ' || (opening_balance + total_credits - total_debits) ||
           ', but closing is ' || closing_balance
      FROM wallet.daily_ledger WHERE closing_balance <> opening_balance + total_credits - total_debits
actions.rule_name: Ledger closing balance does not add up
actions.description: For every wallet and day: closing = opening + credits - debits.

sample_rows.detail: opening 1209.54 + credits 67.60 - debits 0.00 = 1277.14, but closing is 1289.64

actions.check_sql:
WITH t AS (
      SELECT wallet_id, created_at::date AS d,
             sum(CASE WHEN txn_type IN ('deposit', 'p2p_receive') THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS credits,
             sum(CASE WHEN txn_type IN ('withdrawal', 'p2p_send') THEN amount + coalesce(fee, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS debits
        FROM wallet.transactions WHERE status = 'completed' GROUP BY 1, 2)
    SELECT coalesce(l.wallet_id, t.wallet_id) || '@' || coalesce(l.ledger_date, t.d),
           'ledger credits/debits ' || coalesce(l.total_credits, 0) || '/' || coalesce(l.total_debits, 0) ||
           ', transactions ' || coalesce(t.credits, 0) || '/' || coalesce(t.debits, 0)
      FROM wallet.daily_ledger l FULL JOIN t ON t.wallet_id = l.wallet_id AND t.d = l.ledger_date
     WHERE coalesce(l.total_credits, 0) <> coalesce(t.credits, 0) OR coalesce(l.total_debits, 0) <> coalesce(t.debits, 0)
actions.rule_name: Ledger does not match the transactions
actions.description: Daily ledger credits and debits must equal the completed transactions for that wallet and day.

actions.check_sql: SELECT txn_id::text, txn_type || ' of ' || amount FROM wallet.transactions WHERE amount <= 0 OR amount > 10000
actions.description: Amounts must be above zero and at most 10,000.00 per transaction.

actions.check_sql:
SELECT external_ref, count(*) || ' transactions: ' || string_agg(txn_id::text, ', ' ORDER BY txn_id)
      FROM wallet.transactions GROUP BY external_ref HAVING count(*) > 1
actions.rule_name: Payment reference used more than once
actions.description: Each external reference from the payment switch must appear once; a repeat usually means a payment was posted twice.

actions.check_sql: SELECT txn_id::text, 'created_at ' || created_at FROM wallet.transactions WHERE created_at > now() + interval '5 minutes'
actions.description: A transaction can't happen after the moment it is loaded; future dates usually mean a time-zone or clock error.

actions.check_sql:
SELECT t.txn_id::text, 'wallet_id ' || coalesce(t.wallet_id::text, 'NULL') || ' does not exist'
      FROM wallet.transactions t LEFT JOIN wallet.wallets w ON w.wallet_id = t.wallet_id
     WHERE w.wallet_id IS NULL
actions.rule_name: Transaction on a wallet that does not exist
actions.description: Every transaction must belong to an existing wallet.

actions.check_sql:
WITH latest AS (SELECT current_date - 1 AS d),
    daily AS (
      SELECT created_at::date AS d, count(*) AS n FROM wallet.transactions
       WHERE created_at >= current_date - 8 AND created_at < current_date GROUP BY 1),
    base AS (SELECT avg(coalesce(daily.n, 0)) AS avg_n
               FROM latest, generate_series(latest.d - 7, latest.d - 1, interval '1 day') g(day)
               LEFT JOIN daily ON daily.d = g.day::date)
    SELECT latest.d::text, coalesce(daily.n, 0) || ' transactions vs a 7-day average of ' || round(base.avg_n)
      FROM latest CROSS JOIN base LEFT JOIN daily ON daily.d = latest.d
     WHERE coalesce(daily.n, 0) < 0.5 * base.avg_n
actions.description: Yesterday (the latest complete UTC day) should have at least half the average daily volume of the 7 days before it. A day with no transactions at all counts as 0.

actions.check_sql:
SELECT txn_id::text, 'amount ' || amount || ', fee charged ' || fee || ', expected ' ||
           round(least(greatest(amount * 0.015, 0.25), 15.00), 2)
      FROM wallet.transactions
     WHERE txn_type = 'withdrawal' AND amount > 0
       AND fee IS DISTINCT FROM round(least(greatest(amount * 0.015, 0.25), 15.00), 2)
actions.rule_name: Withdrawal fee does not follow the fee rule
actions.description: Instant withdrawal fee = 1.5% of the amount, at least 0.25 and at most 15.00, rounded to the cent (FSD-2026-031 BR-03).

actions.check_sql:
SELECT wallet_id::text, 'currency "' || coalesce(currency, 'NULL') || '"'
      FROM wallet.wallets WHERE currency IS NULL OR currency NOT IN ('USD', 'ZWG', 'ZAR')
actions.description: Wallets hold USD, ZWG or ZAR, as ISO 4217 codes.

actions.check_sql: SELECT wallet_id::text, 'balance ' || balance FROM wallet.wallets WHERE balance < 0
actions.description: Wallets have no overdraft, so a balance below zero means money left that the wallet didn't have.

actions.check_sql:
SELECT w.wallet_id::text, 'customer_id ' || coalesce(w.customer_id::text, 'NULL') || ' does not exist'
      FROM wallet.wallets w LEFT JOIN wallet.customers c ON c.customer_id = w.customer_id
     WHERE c.customer_id IS NULL
actions.description: Every wallet must belong to an existing customer; an orphan wallet can't be reconciled or reported to the regulator.
